fullEngineValidation.reason: This dataset audit does not establish end-to-end validation of engine.js: it lacks the approved USDA CPER bout-duration/velocity predictors, individual dry-matter intake, feed costs, and a confinement arm, and its pasture treatment comparison cannot validate a pasture-versus-confinement counterfactual.
